slides.heading: T1 — Reports Hub & Navigation
slides.note: Reports hub provides real-time business intelligence across all branches.
steps: Open Reports from left sidebar navigation.
Choose target report category (Sales, Stock, Audits, Taxes).
Set dynamic date range (Today, Yesterday, Custom range).
Filter by specific branch or consolidated organization.
Tap View to generate analytics or Export to CSV/PDF.

slides.heading: T2 — Sales and Profit Reports
slides.note: Audit morning reports daily to track sales pacing and cashier reconciliations.
steps: Open Sales Summary or Profit & Loss report.
Review total gross sales, discounts, net revenue, and VAT collected.
Analyze hourly sales trends to identify peak service rushes.
Inspect sales by ordering channel (Dine-in, Takeaway, Online).
Review Sales by Item to rank top-performing menu dishes.

slides.heading: T3 — Control and Audit Reports
slides.where: Location: Reports > Void Audit & Discount Log
slides.note: Regular void audits deter till theft and highlight kitchen order mistakes.
steps: Open Void Audit report to track cancelled tickets and food waste.
Review who authorized each void along with mandatory reason notes.
Inspect Discount report to review total price concessions given.
Cross-examine Food-cost variance (recipe cost vs actual depletion).
Safeguards restaurant revenue against unauthorized floor voids.

slides.heading: T4 — Stock and Purchase Reports
slides.where: Location: Reports > Stock Summary & PO Log
slides.note: Stock valuation reports feed directly into financial balance sheets.
steps: Open Stock Summary report to check current on-hand inventory value.
Review Stock Summary Log to audit historical stock movements.
Inspect Purchase Order Log to check open, received, and cancelled POs.
Identify low-stock items approaching minimum safety thresholds.
Export inventory valuation reports for month-end accounting.
